policy: Record repository facts and proposed controls separately from verified deployed behavior. A passing PR check does not remediate main until an approved merge; no market forecast is issued from invalid signal artifacts.

edges.claim: At main SHA 8e34859a5fb16b20b78e0906466be805d0d14353, the XRP artifact has score 44, confidence 0.0 and provider failures for missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429. Forecast status must be NOT_ISSUED.

The summary repeats moderate/positive and bullish-headline language even though confidence is zero and sentiment provider failed. The signal and summary timestamps match, so the failure is semantic validation rather than stale timestamp at this cutoff.

The current main workflow permits mode=all, dry_run=false by default, unlimited max_prs=0 and write permissions; code includes branch update, comments, merge and branch deletion paths. No evidence in this run establishes that it caused prior merges.
PR #1304 replaces the workflow with a read-only PR inventory and read-only permissions. Exact-head core CI and fail-closed gate passed; main remains unchanged until approved merge.

PR #1305 validates signal confidence/provider availability, emits NOT_ISSUED for invalid signals, writes a deterministic non-directional fallback, and removes scheduled Git push behavior. Exact-head core CI and gate passed; main remains unchanged.

hypotheses.statement: The high bullish headline score may be a topic/sentiment classification artifact because several entries are XRPL consensus or network-protocol research papers rather than independent market-moving disclosures.
disconfirming_evidence: Technical protocol research can eventually affect network utility or investor expectations; its relevance cannot be dismissed categorically.
tests_needed: Label technical papers separately from issuer, regulatory, exchange, flow and market-moving news; compare each class against pre-registered fixed-horizon XRP returns and volatility with leakage-safe walk-forward evaluation.

hypotheses.statement: When provider failure is explicit and confidence is zero, any directional summary is unsupported and should be suppressed regardless of headline polarity.
disconfirming_evidence: A separately validated deterministic rule could produce a forecast without the unavailable provider, but no such rule or calibration evidence is established here.
tests_needed: Merge only after review; then verify main output and test fixed-horizon calibration, baselines and outcome recording before issuing any forecast.

notes: Current main state is confirmed; PR proposals are not deployed controls.
